entries.description: Pre-flight: all six backlog engine facts re-verified against cnb/clefs.ly, cnb/layout.ly, cnb/config.ly with zero drift (engraver replaces every Clef grob via middleCPosition+ottava, clefs.ly:151-162; unconditional Staff install, layout.ly:46; zero clef settings in config.ly; no path hook; size hard-coded (* 3 mag)/height at clefs.ly:124; cache keyed (middleCPosition . ottava) at clefs.ly:108). Configurator 009 s1 record does not request a standard-glyph escape hatch (its clef kinds are glyph/text only). Noted: test-unit.ly does not currently include cnb/clefs.ly - will be added for the new assertions.

Added cnb:clef-style (dozenal default / text / none; unknown values warn and fall back to dozenal) and cnb:clef-text (string renders bold, markup as-is, zero-height guard) to cnb/config.ly; cnb/clefs.ly restructured into cnb:build-dozenal-clef-stencil + cnb:build-text-clef-stencil with a none branch in the engraver setting stencil #f. standard escape hatch deliberately omitted (not requested by Configurator 009 record).

Added cnb:clef-size-semitones (default #f = legacy 3 staff-spaces; number N = N semitones tall regardless of cnb:semitones-per-staff-space) via pure helper cnb:clef-target-height. Cache key reworked from (middleCPosition . ottava) to (style, mcp, ottava, text[text-style only], size, sps, mag) - also fixes latent font-size staleness.

Unit suite 209/209 (was 179; +30 clef assertions, cnb/clefs.ly now included in test-unit.ly). Integration suite 239/239 (332 expressions, 8 specs) incl. new clef-none, clef-text-size, clef-size-dozenal specs and both golden joy-to-the-world specs; regenerated golden SVGs/harvests byte-identical (zero drift with defaults). README Engine Settings table updated.

Added cnb:register-clef! (name def) to cnb/clefs.ly mirroring cnb:register-path! (two-arg deviation from the backlog single-list shape, recorded for the S3 handoff): def alist with required path (notehead-path command format) + anchor-semitones (float), optional height-semitones and color. New cnb:clef-defs table; invalid defs warn and are not registered. Selection via cnb:clef-style custom + new cnb:clef-name setting; cnb:clef-effective-style degrades a missing registration to dozenal with a warning.

Anchor contract per Configurator 009 s1: anchor-semitones is the FLOAT semitone of the glyph TOP edge in the notehead engraver pitch coordinate (middle C = 0); placement reuses the notehead formula (anchor + 2*mcp)/sps * staff-space via pure helper cnb:clef-anchor-y-offset; stencil built with top edge at y=0. Size precedence: cnb:clef-size-semitones > def height-semitones > native path scale. New cnb:clef-gutter-semitones (default #f) widens the right X-extent by N/sps staff-spaces, all rendered styles. Cache key grew name+gutter fields; cnb:register-clef! clears the stencil cache.

Unit suite 254/254 (was 209; +45 assertions: registration/lookup incl. pinned FLOAT-anchor test, invalid-def rejections, custom style resolution/fallback, anchor math at sps-1/2/3, size precedence, gutter math, real stencil geometry via make-path-stencil). Integration suite 245/245 (343 assertions, 9 specs) incl. new tests/clef-custom.json (bbox top edge on the top staff line, height 4 staff-spaces, uniform width, gutter-shifted notehead x) and both golden joy-to-the-world specs; zero golden-baseline drift. README updated.
